title: Transforming Financial Analysis at Scale: How BCI Leverages Claude's Financial Analysis Solution
description: Join Anthropic and British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) for a deep dive into how AI tools like Claude’s Financial Analysis Solution are revolutionizing investment research and financial modeling. See real-world use cases from one of Canada’s leading institutional investors, explore advanced remote terminal capabilities, and discover how MCP integrations create seamless research workflows. This session combines product innovation with proven implementation strategies from the field.
